description: Package the most stable obstruction cores as certificate-carrying lemmas that can be reused across exact branches. The value is cumulative proof state, not archival solver debris.
mathematical_formalization: Each library item L_j carries (core_j, proof_j, transfer_scope_j) with machine-checkable proof_j and empirically validated transfer_scope_j.
analogical_connections: lemma libraries in interactive theorem proving
learned clause reuse across SAT instances
implementation_hypothesis: Emit a small proof object for each core, then track whether it prunes or certifies future branches under symmetry changes.
experiment_seed: Start from the top recurring H1 cores and attach a proof-format stub plus checker-time accounting.
